subject: Invoice re-route & courtesy adjustment — Lumina Health (EU)
messages:
From: Elena Rojas <elena.rojas@luminahealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@luminahealth.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:12:00 +0100
Subject: Request: split invoice & routing change for EU VAT reporting

Hi Mina,

Hope you're well — quick one from our AP team. We received the June invoice (attached) which was billed to Lumina Global (non-EU). For EU VAT reporting and our local reclaim process we need that billing to be routed to Lumina Health B.V. (NL). Can Redwood reissue the invoice split so that:

- Service lines for the period 2027-06-01 — 2027-06-30 are assigned to Lumina Health B.V. (NL) with the correct VAT number included
- Any difference resulting from the misrouting is issued as a credit to Lumina Health B.V. (we'll need a credit note)

We've attached our VAT cert and the original invoice for reference. Also, we had a small spike on the ingest connector that caused an unexpected overage charge on line item #4 — if you can review that we may need a goodwill adjustment for the portion that was clearly an ingestion duplicate.

Can you confirm next steps and whether you can apply the credit before our month-end close (EOM July 1)?

Thanks,
Elena Rojas
Finance Director — Lumina Health
Elena Rojas
Elena.Rojas@luminahealth.com

Attachment: invoice_20270601.pdf
Attachment: Lumina_VAT_certificate.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rojas <elena.rojas@luminahealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: split invoice & routing change for EU VAT reporting

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. I pulled finance and tax in so we can action quickly. Proposed plan:

1) Finance (cc: Laura) will draft a split invoice and a provisional credit note for the overcharge/goodwill portion for Lumina Health B.V.
2) Tax (cc: Vivek) will validate the VAT routing and confirm whether reverse-charge or VAT-inclusive reissue is required for NL jurisdiction.
3) We will aim to issue a provisional credit (memo) within 48 business hours and the formal credit note within 5 business days, pending the VAT decision and your AP details.

To speed things up, can you confirm the following in reply:
- Full legal name to appear on the reissued invoice (and exact VAT ID as shown on certificate)
- AP contact (name + email) for the final invoice routing
- Bank instructions if we need to issue any cash refund (if applicable)

I've attached a short evidence checklist for the Finance team to confirm receipt. Will update you as we make progress.

Best,
Mina
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Attachment: requested_evidence_checklist.pdf
